Game Overview

Viking Escape is a adventure game built around navigate a shadowy forest astride a fire-breathing dragon in Viking Escape. Test your speed and strategy as you fend off goblins and mutants, collecting points and ammunition along the way. With each level's escalating challenge, survival depends on your skill in using both weaponry and fiery breath.
